ADDRESSED.

Evidence:
- The fix is commit cac015a9. It changes only `tests/provider-stream-conformance/tests/conformance.rs`: the openai_chat module doc (about lines 824-826) and the `text_delta` doc (about lines 940-943).
- The new text says the api.openai.com capture "sends that key on its tool-call chunks. It has no text content delta."
- This matches `tests/provider-stream-conformance/fixtures/openai_chat/zero_arg_tool_call.raw`:
  - Chunk 1 is the tool-call opening. It has `delta.content:null` and `"finish_reason":null`.
  - Chunk 2 is the tool-call arguments `{}`. It has `"finish_reason":null`.
  - Chunk 3 has `"finish_reason":"tool_calls"`.
  - Chunk 4 is the usage chunk with `choices:[]`. Then `[DONE]`.
  - No chunk has a text content delta. The same chunks appear in the inline copy at `conformance.rs` lines 1080-1082.
- The old claim about "content-bearing chunks" is gone from both docs.
- The LiteLLM and `chat_text_usage_trailing.txt` "omit it" remark is kept in both docs. The module doc says "The LiteLLM captures omit it." The `text_delta` doc says "`chat_text_usage_trailing.txt` and the LiteLLM captures omit it."
- Chunk 1 does carry `"content":null`, but only as a null value on the opening chunk. "No text content delta" is still accurate.

New issues in the fix diff: none. It is a doc-comment-only change of 5 insertions and 4 deletions. The intra-doc links are unchanged. The sentences are still true.

Out-of-scope observations: none.
